g.title: pr_revision
g.text: Pull request revision: a person's review becomes one new commit on the same branch

g.title: cluster_loop
g.text: Revision loop (3 rounds at most)

g.title: start
g.text: A person requests changes on a pull request
the factory opened, or comments /fix

g.title: read
g.text: Read the pull request and the latest review
from the git host: its comments, line by line

g.title: rules
g.text: Is it the factory's own pull request?
open · same repository · fewer than 3 revisions
something to act on?

g.title: refuse
g.text: a short note (not the factory's · closed · limit reached · nothing to do)
or nothing at all for a review on someone else's pull request

g.title: rules->refuse
g.text: no

g.title: intake
g.text: Check out the pull request's own branch
read .factory/project.json

g.title: rules->intake
g.text: yes

g.title: resolver
g.text: pr-resolver
for each numbered comment: fixed, answered,
declined (with a reason) or needs clarification

g.title: answers
g.text: every comment answered exactly once?
\"fixed\" must mean files really changed

g.title: answers->resolver
g.text: no: sent back with the reason

g.title: checks
g.text: change checks + the project's checks

g.title: answers->checks
g.text: files changed

g.title: replied
g.text: Reply on the pull request: nothing was pushed,
with the answer to each comment

g.title: answers->replied
g.text: no file changed:
all answered or declined

g.title: reviewers
g.text: reviewers look at the revision
(acceptance check only for larger revisions)

g.title: ok
g.text: everything passes?

g.title: ok->resolver
g.text: no: feedback

g.title: push
g.text: Push ONE new commit onto the same branch
never forced; refused if someone pushed meanwhile

g.title: ok->push
g.text: yes

g.title: wip
g.text: Nothing pushed to the pull request
work saved on a -wip branch + a comment

g.title: ok->wip
g.text: out of rounds
or blocked

g.title: reply
g.text: Reply on the pull request: the commit,
a table of what was done per comment, the checks

g.title: again
g.text: A person reviews again and merges
(the factory never merges)
